title: Confidential Session: Legal, Land, Gifts
summary:
*   The entire meeting was dedicated to a closed (executive) session.
*   Discussions in the private session covered sensitive topics such as legal advice, real estate transactions, and potential gifts or security measures.
*   Any final actions or decisions stemming from these confidential discussions were to be announced and voted on in a future public meeting.
